fha.description: FHA mortgage insurance premiums (upfront + annual), MIP duration, minimum financing rule, 2026 national loan limit floor/ceiling for one-unit homes.
fha.source_title: HUD Mortgagee Letter 2023-05 (MIP); HUD press release No. 25-145 (2026 loan limits); HUD Mortgagee Letter 2026-11 (credit score methodology)
fha.notes: No later MIP-rate change was found in searches; ML 2026-11 (Oct 8, 2026) 'doesn't change' MIP and states 'the existing minimum credit score thresholds remain unchanged'; its LTV table reads 'at or above 580 eligible for maximum financing'. 96.5% max LTV quoted in ML 2026-11 is in the HUD REO section; 3.5% min down payment is the implied complement (1 - 0.965) — not stated verbatim on a fetched HUD page (hud.gov/buying/loans returned no loan text). Loan-limit ML number 2025-23 inferred from the link filename '2025-23hsgml.pdf' on the press release page. Streamline refis of pre-2009-06-01 FHA loans use 0.55% annual / 0.01% upfront.

arm.description: Conforming SOFR ARM structure (index, margin, caps, reset frequency) and a current MBA 5/1 ARM rate.
arm.source_title: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B2-1.4-02 Adjustable-Rate Mortgages (12/10/2025); MGIC 'Getting Comfortable with ARMs' handout (04.10.26); Mortgage News Daily on MBA weekly survey (2026-10-16)
arm.date: Fannie guide topic 2025-12-10; MGIC handout 2026-04-10; MBA data week ending 2026-10-09 (published 2026-10-16); fetched 2026-10-22
arm.notes: Index, 45-day lookback, 300 bp max margin and 1/8 rounding are from Fannie Mae's Selling Guide. Fannie's guide defers plan-level caps to its Standard ARM Plan Matrix, which could not be fetched; caps (2/1/5 for 3/6 & 5/6; 5/1/5 for 7/6 & 10/6), 6-month reset and 'typically 2% to 3%' margin are from the MGIC handout (mortgage insurer, secondary source citing Fannie B2-1.4-02 / Freddie 4401.1). MNDN article does not explicitly label the figures 'average contract rate'. Freddie Mac PMMS discontinued ARM rates in Nov 2022.

points.description: Discount points: PMMS publication status, latest PMMS rates, and official guidance on rate reduction per point.
points.source_title: Freddie Mac PMMS; CFPB 'What are discount points?' (Ask CFPB); CFPB newsroom 2024-04-05 'CFPB finds Americans are paying upfront fees...'
points.date: PMMS 2026-10-22; Ask CFPB last reviewed 2023-10-19; CFPB release 2024-04-05; fetched 2026-10-22
points.notes: PMMS: 'In November 2022, adjustable rates and fees/points were discontinued'; Freddie Mac 'is not able to report on the average fees and points.' CFPB: 'discount points have no fixed value in terms of the change in interest rate'; reduction depends on 'the specific lender, the kind of loan, and market conditions'. No official fixed rule (e.g., 0.25%/point) was found — treat as a user input. The CFPB example (0.375 pts -> -0.125 pp) is a single illustration. CFPB 2024: ~61% of purchase borrowers paid points in Sep 2023 (31% in 2021); 65% of FHA borrowers.

sofr.description: Latest SOFR averages (ARM index) and NY Fed terms of use for reference-rate data.
sofr.source_title: NY Fed Markets Data API (rates/all/latest); NY Fed SOFR Averages and Index page; NY Fed Terms of Use
sofr.notes: Terms: users who use/distribute reference rate data must include a notice that the data 'is subject to the Terms of Use posted at newyorkfed.org' and that 'The New York Fed is not responsible for publication of the [DATA NAME] by [NAME OF PUBLISHER]', does not sanction or endorse any republication, 'and has no liability for your use.' SOFR is 'calculated using data provided under a license granted to the New York Fed by DTCC Solutions LLC.' 'None of the Content is investment advice.' The averages page states: 'Use of the Reference Rates are subject to important disclaimers, limitations and indemnification obligations.' Averages published each business day ~8:00 a.m. ET.

bls_series.description: BLS PPI series for homeowners insurance and CPI area codes / publication frequency for Rent of primary residence.
bls_series.source_title: BLS cu.area file; BLS 'CPI 2018 geographic revision' page; BLS Boston CPI news release (2026-10-14); FRED series PCU5241265241262 (source: BLS)
bls_series.notes: Area codes are verbatim from the official BLS cu.area file. Boston release confirms series CUURS11ASEHA and 'published bi-monthly' (Sep 2026 release, next Dec 10, 2026 for Nov). Frequencies from the 2018 revision page; schedule changes since then not verified for every area. data.bls.gov is robots-disallowed, so the PPI series ID/start date come from FRED (BLS source). FRED series page showed Aug 2026 = 290.436 while FRED data table showed 290.732 (likely revision); the data table values are recorded. FRED also carries Boston rent under legacy code CUURA103SEHA (monthly, Dec 1914-Aug 2026, last 493.760) — a FRED continuity series; the official BLS ID is CUURS11ASEHA. Charlotte/Raleigh/Austin/Las Vegas should use South or West Size Class A/BC regional series.

acs.description: Census ACS 1-year API variable IDs for property taxes, home value and rent by bedrooms; MSA query pattern; terms.
acs.source_title: Census API variable metadata (2024 ACS1); Census API examples for 2024 ACS1; Census press release 2026-10-13 (2025 ACS 1-year dates); Census Data API Terms of Service
acs.notes: B25031_003E/005E/006E not individually fetched (expected 1/3/4 bedrooms by sequence, not verified). 2025 ACS1 endpoint returned an error on 2026-10-22; 2025 1-year estimates are scheduled for 2026-10-29. A keyless call to the 2024 endpoint returned an error requiring a valid API key. Example MSA code 35620 (New York) comes from Census's examples page. Terms: services must display 'This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.'; users may not use data 'to identify any individual person, household, business or other entity.'

llpa.what: Fannie Mae Loan-Level Price Adjustment (LLPA) Matrix, purchase money loans, terms over 15 years: percent of the loan by credit score (rows) and LTV (columns)

reference.why: Freddie Mac's survey rate is for borrowers with 20% down and good to excellent credit (freddiemac.com/pmms)

llpa.exempt: LLPAs are waived for first-time homebuyers with income at or below 100% of area median income (120% in high-cost areas), and for HomeReady loans.

pmi_fico.what: Annual PMI by credit score at 96.5% LTV relative to 760+ (Urban Institute, Housing Finance at a Glance, September 2026; premiums 0.46%–1.50% of the loan)
pmi_fico.source_title: Urban Institute, Housing Finance at a Glance: A Monthly Chartbook, September 2026
